name: humanizer
title_zh: 只认维基百科那份AI写作痕迹清单的文本去味器
tagline_zh: 改稿时总被说“一看就是AI写的”？它按维基百科的权威清单逐条排查，专治破折号滥用、规则三连、空洞比喻，让文字像人话。
tagline_en: Stuck with robotic prose? It runs your draft against Wikipedia's full list of AI-writing tells—em-dash spam.
desc_en: Remove signs of AI-generated writing from text. Use when editing or reviewing text to make it sound more natural and human-written. Based on Wikipedia's comprehensive "Signs of AI writing" guide. Detects and fixes patterns including: inflated symbolism, promotional language, superficial -ing analyses, vague attributions, em dash overuse, rule of three, AI vocabulary words, negative parallelisms, a
why_zh: 不靠玄学语感，而是把维基百科的《AI写作迹象》指南变成可执行的检查项，逐条比对，改得有理有据。
why_en: Instead of vague advice, it operationalizes Wikipedia's guide into concrete, checkable patterns, so edits are transparent and.
limit_zh: 只处理英文文本；需要联网获取维基百科原文；不保证改写后通过所有AI检测器；对创意写作或口语化文本可能过度修正。
limit_en: English only; needs internet for the Wikipedia source; won't guarantee passing AI detectors; may over-correct creative or colloquial writing.
title_en: De-AI your text with Wikipedia's telltale-signs checklist
